nuggets.text: The Hilltoppers' mascot, Big Red, is a red, furry blob that WKU student Ralph Carey created in 1979.
Big Red's first costume was handmade from air conditioner foam, fake fur, plastic tubing and aluminum framing.
The Hilltoppers won the 2002 Division I-AA national title under Jack Harbaugh, father of Jim and John Harbaugh.
Coach Tyson Helton comes from a coaching family: his father Kim and brother Clay were both college head coaches.
WKU defensive coordinator Davis Merritt worked on Georgia's defensive staff during its back-to-back national title runs.
The Hilltoppers went 6-0 to close last season after Rodney Tisdale Jr. took over at quarterback.
Former Hilltopper Rod Smart wore "He Hate Me" on his XFL jersey, and it became the league's best-selling uniform.
The Hilltoppers' first win over an SEC team came in 2012, an upset of Kentucky in Lexington.
Quarterback Rodney Tisdale Jr. was named Conference USA Freshman of the Year last season.
The Hilltoppers and Bulldogs have met just once before, back in 2006.
